candidate_relations.reason: Chest pain, ST elevation, and troponin elevation resemble acute coronary syndrome, but normal coronary arteries, apical ballooning, and an adrenal mass support pheochromocytoma-induced stress cardiomyopathy instead.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Acute coronary syndrome is an initial clinical mimic/differential, not the etiologic cardiomyopathy diagnosis.

candidate_relations.reason: The adrenal mass and systolic apical ballooning with normal coronary arteries support pheochromocytoma-induced Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, equivalent to the reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pheochromocytoma-associated Takotsubo cardiomyopathy matches the required cause and cardiac manifestation.

case_quality_flags: Biochemical or histopathologic confirmation of pheochromocytoma is not provided in the clinical record, although it is specified by the benchmark diagnosis.
